comments.body:
Quest name: Medicine or Poison? (Chrono Quest - 14th Century)
Quest location: St. Petersburg Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r13 Ecological Research, r15 Biology, CHN(Chinese)
Pre-requisite discovery: The Travels of Marco Polo discovery (from "Adventurer's bible" quest) + Xanadu discovery (from "The promised future" quest)
Additional note: "Aftermath" part of Xanadu/Great Adventurer questchain
